notes.title: Oneiric Update
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024061/cab776ecb32c25a815466b6f8121fae2034599c8.png"][/img][/p][h1]The Oneiric Card Set[/h1][p]The 7th aspect of the Pale Gods - The Dream horde made real.[/p][p]The new set is available and incorporated into the main game.[/p][p]This set tries to offer alternative deckbuilding avenues for existing archetypes, bending the rules of the game further.[/p][p][i]Note: This set offers great opportunities for broken builds, have fun![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024061/f727c97f02a4b62b7814254298724e43157e55cd.png"][/img][/p][h2]Shiver[/h2][p][b]Shiver[/b] is a new keyword, forcing the player to discard the top X cards from their draw pile. For any card that can not be discarded, the player suffers stagger. [/p][p]All related discard synergies work with shiver, including cards that activate when discarded.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024061/2a6b96438c0889419306ea7ef2d1afea485a99b0.png"][/img][/p][h2]New cards[/h2][list][*][p]37 new Oneiric cards[/p][/*][*][p]12 new cards, 2 per existing card set[/p][/*][*][p]1 new divine card[/p][/*][*][p]2 new special, battle only cards[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Note: The existing sets each got a new uncommon and rare, enabling new interesting interactions.[/i][/p][h2]New Monstrosities:[/h2][list][*][p]4 new enemies for the Oneiric set — countering exile and discard, while they shiver your deck away[/p][/*][*][p]2 new bosses: 1 for Act 1, and 1 for Act 2[/p][/*][/list][h2]Player Characters[/h2][list][*][p]2 new player characters have been added:[/p][/*][*][p][b]Slayer[/b], trade life for stamina, hit to regain life[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alyse[/b], vessel of the dream horde[/p][/*][/list][h2]Events[/h2][p]Some event options have been adjusted, mostly to make them more viable.[/p][h2]Card changes[/h2][list][*][p]Stillness: Armor scales with arcane.[/p][/*][*][p]Seer Stone: destory a Monolith within range 2: Draw 2 Cards. Exile for a turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Cataclysmic Punch: Base damage is 20 (0). Strength multiplier 10 (12). No self stagger.[/p][/*][*][p]Waking the Fallen: Range increased to 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Obsidian Teeth: Collision gain 2 (1).[/p][/*][*][p]Doom Presence: Base damage is 8 (0).[/p][/*][*][p]Gorge: Nomnom Monolith: Gain 1 Stamina. Exile for a turn. (just simpler to utilize)[/p][/*][*][p]Overpower: No longer draw 1 card. Costs 0. (A cheap collision tool)[/p][/*][*][p]Hail Barrage: second collision reduced to 2 (3). (It was a bit too much for 0 cost)[/p][/*][*][p]Assimilate: Base damage is 10 (5)  (chomp those monsters)[/p][/*][*][p]Embers in the Dark: Now can only trigger up to 5 times per round. (A certain new Eye ritual makes this a bomb)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Balance[/h2][p]I have a feeling this new set is a bit overtuned, but it is rather fun, so currently i lean on letting it run wild for a bit. I will only nerf something completely simple but overpowered. If you have any feedback, don't hesitate to reach me, on Steam or Discord.[/p]

notes.title: Update 2.0.6
notes.content:
[h1]Card changes[/h1]
- Upheaval damage is now 15 from 14 (just to have a rounded total number...)
- Walk on Embers now also self Ignites for 1, both nerf and trigger for certain curios
- Primordial Blood and Bloody Trail now add a Hemorrhage in your DRAW PILE instead of costing HP. see notes
- Dark Below: Now just consumes random shadows and monoliths, super powered Strength gains
- Soul Shatter: Normal damage is now 3x3, Arcane damage is 2x4
- Waking the Fallen: Base damage per 2 shadows is 10 (was 8)
- Void Lance: Enhance 5 from 6. No longer needs to consume a shadow, instead it always adds a Photasthenia. See notes

[h1]Other[/h1]
- Fixed enhance weird sfx
- Fixed a bug where Fractured Mind exile would keep growing (sorry!)
- Fixed some effect behavior related to turn end flow (permafrost, grand scheme)

Notes:
Some cards where adjusted to add ANATHEMA instead of directly causing an effect. Generally this makes them stronger in shorter fights but more painful in longer fights. Additionally extra ANATHEMA related synergies are a bit more widely available outside of EYE / YELLOW.

notes.title: Boreal Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024061/0b7187e05a779d83042112eff0c018825432f284.png[/img]


[h1]The Boreal Card Set:[/h1]
The 6th aspect of the Pale Gods — chaos from the frozen wasteland.
The new set is incorporated directly into the existing game, with some adjustments to make all six sets fit harmoniously.
Two new mechanisms are introduced in the new set:

[h3]FREEZE:[/h3]
A frozen card does not get discarded at the end of the turn. The freeze effect lasts until the card is played. This allows for great future turn planning or ensuring you can dodge an attack when you really need to.

[h3]RESONANCE:[/h3]
Resonance activates additional effects on cards if you meet the Stagger threshold. Even if you are STAGGERED, these effects activate, rewarding risky play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024061/eda9402ce6ae21b6ca9687f2b4887cfd02c8c4ee.png[/img]

[h2]New Cards:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 35 new BOREAL cards
[*] 5 new DIVINE cards
[*] 1 new special card (generated by a Curio and a Divine card)
[/list]

[h2]New Monstrosities:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 4 new enemies for the Boreal set — they try to stagger you and always freeze your ANATHEMAS
[*] 2 new bosses: 1 for Act 1, and 1 for Act 2
[/list]

[h2]Player Characters:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 2 new player characters have been added:
[*] Ronin, with a unique twist on how to engage the enemies
[*] Jonah, the ghost of the frozen wastes
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b] for unlocking have been reduced for some characters.
[i]NOTE: If a character should have been unlocked but isn’t, start a game and just lose :)[/i]

[h2]New Curios:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 4 new curios have been added
[/list]

[h2]Library:[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Tome: Frozen Doom — This expensive tome makes a card ALWAYS freeze any time you draw it. A very powerful effect.
[*] Tome Reroll: The Librarian allows you to regenerate the current tomes by paying a price. The price increases by 50 for the duration of the run. Use it wisely.
[/list]

[h2]Grudge:[/h2]
[list]
[*] There are now 6 available colors, but to complete a grudge, you only need to hunt 5 out of 6. This was done to avoid increasing the requirements to fulfill a grudge.
[*] This is a small buff for the player, as it's now slightly easier to fulfill grudges and skip the one color you really don’t care about.
[*] Grudge card reward is now +30 rarity (was +20).
[/list]

[h2]Path:[/h2]
[list]
[*] On average, you will have more options more often per step on the path. This was done to balance the total availability of each color.
[/list]

[h2]Events:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Additional events have been added related to the Boreal set
[*] Improved rewards for all event options that force you to suffer an ANATHEMA. Risk/reward.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fix:[/h2]
[list]
[*] FIXED: When using Lantern Surge (or when some enemies change phase), some enemy effects with the keyword "On player start position" would not properly update the UI, failing to alert the player they were about to be hit. No more trickery!
[*] 
[/list]

[h2]CARD CHANGE LOG:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Devourer: Base damage is now 4 (was 3)
[*] Omen of Desolation: Now also lets you move 1 (so you CAN discard your entire hand and maybe not get bonked)
[*] Veinseeker: Damage increased to 20 (was 15)
[*] Essence Siphon: On-hit requirement removed — now ALWAYS gives +1 Arcane when played. Magical!
[*] Fractured Mind: Card rarity is affected by Arcane. If you have at least 1 Arcane, there is a chance to generate a Divine card (yes, even itself — why not). Additionally, you must EXILE a card after one is added (no more junk).
[*] Grand Scheme: REWORKED. The old version no longer made sense with FREEZE in the game. Now it lets you draw cards at the start of your turn equal to the number you had at the end of your last turn. A very good deck-cycling card now.
[/list]

[h2]A personal note from me![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024061/e9f10f6987d9fb062b4c0b4378c7b3a6aa717fd8.png[/img]
Hello! I am Nick, the solo developer (and artist...) of this game. There is no publisher, no machine behind all this, just me (and some very helpful beta testers!)

Thank you for playing my game! 

I put a lot into it, trying to create a good unique deckbuilding game with a new take on the lovecraftian / cosmic horror themes. 

I hope you enjoy all the new cards, and create some amazing decks. Feel free to reach out about anything, easiest way is through the game discord (linked in Steam and in game)

Have fun, go break the game!

notes.title: The Dreamlands
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024061/472b463208b412ccb312076d5630e82adb90540d.png[/img]

Patch notes - Version 1.1.3

[list]
[*] New alternative game mode: Boss rush
[*] Alternative game modes now unlock after reaching Hunt 2 (It was 5)
[*] Mini cards in end game and history pages can now be inspected via right clicking them.
[/list]

[h2]BOSS RUSH[/h2]
A much quicker way to play the game. It removes some of the nuances of deckbuilding, but it gives the same power arc in a much more compact playtime.
[list]
[*] Character choice is only visual in this mode. They have no unique curios or cards due to the diminished nature of the boss rush mode.
[*] Curio list for this mode is filtered to exclude some curios that are not relevant.
[*] There are only 9 fights. Each fight has more card rewards but colors are always mixed.
[*] No lanterns, instead some healing runes are guaranteed, good luck.
[/list]

On starting a boss rush:
[list]
[*] Gain 3 curios
[*] Gain 2 Move cards
[*] Draft 15 cards from all colors mixed (no skipping)
[*] Banish 3 cards
[*] Gain 1 random Anathema
[/list]

Then fight:
[list]
[*] Exalted (strong variant)
[*] Act 1 boss - A
[*] Act 1 boss - B
[*] Library
[*] Exalted (strong variant)
[*] Act 2 boss - A
[*] Act 2 boss - B
[*] Library
[*] Wayward Child
[*] Lantern Keeper
[*] The Pale Prophet
[/list]


... In the Dreamlands... there are glimpses of a boreal frozen wasteland... an omen of things to come...

notes.title: The Nightmare Grows!
notes.content:
New enemies, card balance and various improvements. 

[h1]AVAILABLE IN THE DEMO[/h1]
[h2]NEW ENEMIES[/h2]
Added 1 new enemy per color.
The new enemies are now part of the normal roster. There are now 4 enemies per color.
Their cards are slightly off color pattern, using tactics from other colors.

[h2]ENEMY MOVEMENT PREVIEW[/h2]
Now enemies indicate where exactly they will move on their turn in relation to the player position.
Additionally, when a player has to select a new space to move, the enemy preview adjust live to help make an informed decision. 
Now it is easier to trick enemies into terrain! 

[h2]Hieronymus boss rework[/h2]
Hieronymus has been tweaked to fit more his theme, and provide a more fair fight. The ANATHEMA cards he adds to the player deck is regulated and he always give the player enough time to manage them before retaliating.

[h2]Card changes:[/h2]
- Juggernaut: Armor 15 -> 12. Stagger 4 -> 3
- Rewind: Damage 10 -> 8
- Shimmer: Armor 10 - 6
- The Eye Guides: Arcane scaling 1. -> 0.5 
- Conflagrate: Now enhances after you play it and not only if it hits.
- A.W. Boomstick: Damage 15 x 2 -> 18 x 2.
- Reload!: Now puts the Boomstick in your draw pile (was discard pile) an also draws a card. 
- Glorious light: was range 2 deal 9 arcane dmg. Now is: Range 3: Deal 5 arcane dmg. Range 2: Deal 5 arcane dmg.
- Incinerate: Ignite 5 -> 7. No longer enhances on hit. Instead it removes up to 3 burning from the player.
- Searing Strike: Damage 6 - > 7
- Scientia occulta: Removed the once per round limiter.
- Detonate: Now works on any range. Make things go BOOM!
- Eternal Eye: Range increased to 2 from 1 (melee)
- Host of Cinders: Only adds 1 Pyromania.
- Pray to the Flame: Adds 3 random monoliths, was 2. Now also exiles 1 card from your hand. (Hint: maybe the one that burns you?)
- True Flame: Range increased to 2 from 1(melee)
- Shadow Limb: Damage increased to 4 from 3
- Fiend of the Night: Now also grants +2 Strength for a turn.
- Vanish: Stamina cost 1. Consume a shadow to gain 1 stamina. Move 2. 
- Ether Bolt: Range increase to 3 from 2.

[h2]Bloodlust [/h2]
Bloodlust primordial buff: No longer heals them for 20% of their max HP
Now it only heals 5% of max hp, but also gives them ARMOR equal to 20% of their max hp.
bloodlust now triggers AFTER a card is fully resolved, no longer escaping death if a card would kill them and stagger them.

[h2]Fixes, changes and additions[/h2]
- Exalted enemies eat their breakfast. They are now bigger (visually) than the normal variants.
- Shadow effect on spaces has been reworked to fit more with the artstyle of the game.
- The Glossary in the Esoteric Archive is now alphabetically sorted.
- Fixed display bug in card text condition line.
- Fixed revenant not suffering HP loss on a new run at hunt 7 or higher.
- Fixed FIREBOMB curio not registering as found, sorry!
- Fixed SUMMONING TOME curio spawning Monoliths too far
- Fixed ABYSSAL PEARL curio triggering on 2, it now triggers on 3
- Fixed text on some cards that read as "once per turn" to "once per round" in all applicable cases
- Fixed term in confirmation dialog that was confusing
- Avaron unlock burning damage requirement was reduced.
- Added Wayward Child boss art
- Added player character visibility when directly behind bigger enemies
- Added new curio: Alejandro's Fumigator. Stops enemies from healing (Wayward SETS his HP, he does not heal, in case you where wondering)
- Improved card readability regarding conditional effects (Beta tester power!)
- Fix bug where some players curios were duplicated on game load
- Fix bug when editing settings out of combat would crash the game
- Minor reworks in boss conditions
- Player walk UI is now always above the board, some bosses were obscuring it
- Improved tooltips
- Improved tutorials
- Fixed typos

[h2]STATS AND HISTORY[/h2]
- The game now tracks total wins and maximum hunt level per character. Stats can be found in Character selection screen. They are visible after a least a run with a character is finished.
- The game now keeps a history of the past 10 runs (abandoned runs are not tracked). History can be found in the Esoteric Archive.


[h1]POST DEMO - FULL GAME PROGRESS[/h1]
A small update on the overall progress of the game.
- All card art is now completed! YEY
- All act 2 Boss art is complete! (5 bosses in total, much more.. lovecraftian than act 1, no more mere humans)
- Act 3 First mini boss art is complete
TODO:
- Act 3 Second mini boss and final boss art is pending.
- Act 2 and 3 Event art is pending.

[h1]CALL TO ACTION[/h1]
If you are interested, and want to help make this game better, feel free to join the discord server and even get a key for the closed beta.

notes.title: Demo and Beta test feedback update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45024061/41508ed84ebc74e00bc8b7962857e6a765056b36.png[/img]

Most of the following bugs, typos and improvements were found or suggested by the demo players and the beta testers. A big thank you to all, making this a better game.

Changelog:
- Fixed typos...
- Fixed EVENT: "Grotesque Statue" 
- Made all "close" buttons more obvious
- Added "sort by" functionality in player deck list. Sorting options: Default, Aspect (color), Type, Cost, Rarity.
- Added tip in card list and curio list pages to inform users about the "right click to inspect"
- Added fx when hiding a list page to point the user back to the show button
- Improved attribute tooltips and buff description. They are more clear now, and arcane indicates it can increase other effects.
- Fixed a bug with Lantern Surge, it no longer hard locks 
- Fixed a bug where stamina reduction from event was not persisted after loading a save file
- Added two new divine cards
   - Flames of Wrath: Turns all ignite into attack that deal 3 times the ignite value. ANGRY FLAME PUNCHING!
   - Bleak Jungle: Consume 2 shadows instead of discard a card if able. Discard effects trigger even if a card is not discarded this way.
- Added a bunch of new divine card art
- Add FX on move and push
- Improved rock related particles
- Move effect text on cards is red if move value is reduced to zero (by agility loss)
- Added total anathema indication in deck button and in deck list page
- Added the option to OFFER in "King in Rags" event, it also disables the rune option if the player has no runes
- Reduce curio and condition size slightly, possibly a new setting will be added for even further reduction (compact mode)
- Improve organization for settings page
- Added new "Big text mode" option. Make action text in card much bigger with higher contrast. In some cases partially hides the art.
- Generally improved available space for card action text.
